items.storyText: Hi. I'm Beth. I'm at the park with my family. It's windy today. Oh no! Where's Grandpa's hat? Grandpa's hat is in the tree! My dad jumps. No, Grandpa's hat is still in the tree. My mum throws a ball. No, Grandpa's hat is still in the tree. My brother gets on Dad's shoulders. Can he get the hat? Yes, he can! Here's Grandpa with his hat. He's happy now.
